card.name: Unit counts after a dose amount
card.fires_on: The unit word (tablets or mL) right after a number inside parentheses or after a strength, in dosing tables and schedules. It marks the amount of product that makes up a dose.

modes.label: Tablets in parentheses
modes.description: The word tablets after a count and often a strength, giving the number of tablets that equal a mg dose.
